Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionGet ready for a feline adventure filled with adorable pieces, clever combinations, and toys scattered everywhere in Whisker Mess! In this fun tile-fitting puzzle, you must place cat-shaped pieces across the board, create lines, and clear the way while earning points and making room for new moves. By completing horizontal, vertical, and, on certain levels, even diagonal lines, you clear pieces, remove toys from the board, and turn every move into a new strategic opportunity. But be careful: blockers act as extensions of the walls and can completely change the way lines are formed! With 30 levels divided into 3 biomes, Whisker Mess gradually introduces new challenges. As you progress, you'll encounter special toys with different behaviors, requiring you to carefully observe the board, adapt your plans, and discover how to make the most of each effect. With no time pressure, Whisker Mess offers a relaxing and accessible experience, while still providing plenty of possibilities for those who enjoy thinking several moves ahead. With different board layouts, varied blockers, and combinations of special toys, each level brings a new challenge to test your creativity and spatial reasoning. Fit the pieces, create lines, clear the mess, and help turn this feline chaos into pure fun!Show morePublished byAfil GamesDeveloped byAfil GamesPlay withXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADESEach decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWSCelebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls- "No Scrubs" by TLC- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel- "Mamma Mia" by ABBAAND MORE!From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's track list is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together!DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONSExplore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits!ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTYDance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode or get moving with Workout Mode.
